currentObligation.reason: The language model timed out. Use the already-observed safe candidate “Close the blocking interface” once, verify its outcome, then retry language reasoning.

objective.label: Maintain safe verified play while the language model reconnects

teacherLessons.text: When a dialogue blocks progress, advance the listed dialogue option and verify that the interface changes or closes before selecting another goal. Treat the resulting game message and world-state change as the lesson.
